chunks: And with this chain of narration, it was said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Circumcise your children on the seventh day; for it is cleaner and faster for the growth of the flesh.
ai.seo_question: When should male children be circumcised according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* underscores the Sunnah of circumcising male children on the seventh day, a practice deeply rooted in the tradition of the Prophet and the Imams as a means of ritual purity (taharah) and physical health. Scholars highlight that this specific timing aligns with the completion of the initial post-natal period, facilitating easier healing and integration into the community's religious identity.
